decisions.reason: The 65 mm bushing-space dimension belongs to the separate locking-interface geometry Requirement; it does not change the candidate's bushing location, attachment, clearance, or rod-path rules.
Changing the locking-thread width and bushing-space length does not alter the specified raw material, fabrication sequence, premachining purpose, or post-weld 82 mm internal machining.
The keyway-omission rule is an independent clause and remains unchanged by the locking-thread and bushing-space dimensions.
The locking-interface geometry change does not modify the requirement to align drawing numbering with assembly position numbering.
The source changes geometry only and does not revise the specified S355 JRG2 or CuSn12 material selections.
The geometry revision does not change the requested IPT or STEP model-file formats.
The source establishes specific locking-interface dimensions but does not change the independent requirement concerning drawing dimension content or presentation.
